priority.override_reason: Lead selects this bounded OwnSlot leaf before method-resolution pricing from T036; global sinks and class-field units belong to other owners.

mechanism.summary: Answer an already installed OwnSlot hot entry without entering get_prop_named and scanning all four cache entries. Use an out-of-line helper borrowing the entry; retain weak receiver identity, layout revision, live slot read, and caller exotic guards.
mechanism.generality: All ordinary named reads on stable own-slot storage; selection depends on cache representation and guarded receiver state, never source, key spelling or corpus shape. Expected net 20-60 instructions / 3-10 cycles per reached hit; cdjs reach is small and near-neutral target threshold is deliberate.
semantic_risks: A different receiver with the same epoch must decline
Writes must return the live slot value; deleting or replacing a descriptor must invalidate the entry
Accessor, typed-array, symbol and module-namespace semantics must keep the existing general path
Prototype hot entries and alternating receivers must retain existing proofs
